name: cleanNullString
expected: Returns null because the input string is null, as explicitly checked by `str == null`.

name: cleanEmptyString
expected: Returns an empty string because `str.length() == 0` evaluates to true.

name: cleanLowercaseLettersOnly
expected: Returns "ABCDEF" because all characters are letters and converted to uppercase using ENGLISH locale.

name: cleanUppercaseLettersOnly
expected: Returns "ABCDEF" because all characters are already uppercase letters and `count == len` triggers the optimized upper-casing path.

name: cleanMixedCaseWithNonLetters
expected: Returns "ABCXYZ" because digits and symbols are filtered out via `Character.isLetter`, and letters are converted to uppercase.

name: cleanOnlyNonLetters
expected: Returns "" (empty string) because no characters satisfy `Character.isLetter`, resulting in `count = 0`.

name: cleanSingleLowercaseLetter
expected: Returns "Z" because it is a single valid letter converted to uppercase.

name: cleanSingleNonLetter
expected: Returns "" because the single character is not a letter.

name: cleanWhitespaceAndTabs
expected: Returns "" because whitespace characters are not considered letters by `Character.isLetter`.

name: cleanUnicodeLetters
expected: Returns properly uppercased accented characters since `Character.isLetter` recognizes Unicode letters and `toUpperCase` handles them.

name: cleanMixedLettersAndSpaces
expected: Returns "HELLOWORLD" because the space character is filtered out and the remaining letters are uppercased.

name: cleanLeadingAndTrailingNonLetters
expected: Returns "SMITH" because hyphens and plus signs are stripped out.
